title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.6
exact_target: Does every transitive Sylow p-subgroup of a transitive finitary permutation group contain a transitive subgroup whose individual cycle supports are blocks?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2515 (KOU-21.6). CC BY 4.0.

A. O. Asar, Problem 21.6, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026). See also source definitions in Problems 15.23.
